Query1 omits the env and consumer_group template-variable matchers (env=~"$env", consumer_group=~"$consumer_group"), so it selects a different set of series than the Datadog request.

Query2 groups by host_name, which is not among the observed dataset labels for kafka.consumer_group.offset (observed: group, topic, type, service_name, service_instance_id), so the grouping cannot be trusted to resolve in the target dataset.
Query2 also drops env from the grouping and omits the same env and consumer_group matchers as query1.
Metric quantity, unit (1) and sum aggregation are consistent with the OTel gauge definitions, and no Datadog function is present, so a translated outcome is the correct outcome.
